name: vision_main_n1652_mlp_pool10
head: mlp

train_config.sizes: all nested sizes found in the selection

input: 10 frames at decision_time-1.5 ... decision_time (evenly spaced, newest decoded frame with PTS<=target; reject if >0.10 s stale), letterbox to 224x224 (ffmpeg scale bilinear + pad colour #7c7468), RGB, ImageNet mean/std normalisation
label_policy: fho_transfer_v1_draft3 (1 = take/put completed in the last 1.5 s; 0 = ongoing non-transfer hand action; weak labels from Ego4D FHO)

pooling.pool10: per-frame standardisation (frame_mu/frame_sd), then concat[mean_t, max_t, x_last-x_first, mean_t|x_t-x_{t-1}|] -> 2304, then rep standardisation (rep_mu/rep_sd)

notes: MAIN vision model. Selection v2 train_all (1652). Eval set: selection v2 eval (413 usable windows).
